An excerpt of the ChEBI flat files (release 257,
https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/chebi/flat_files/): the rows for every
ChEBI id the BiGG fixture (../bigg) mentions, their charge forms and
tautomers up to three links away, their "is a" parents up to two steps up
(CHEBI:17634 D-glucose, CHEBI:17234 glucose, ...) and their direct "is a"
children (CHEBI:17925 alpha-D-glucose, ...), with the relations among them.
README is ChEBI's own. Used only by the tests.

ChEBI data is from http://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi - the version of ChEBI is 257.
